headline: Leaders of China, Russia and US to discuss "world peace"
summary: The presidents of China, Russia and the United States will hold their first trilateral meeting on Thursday on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen. The talks will address global peace.
why: Relations among China, Russia and the United States shape trade, sanctions and security risks that affect global markets and supply chains.
original_headline: Líderes de China, Rusia y EU hablarán sobre la “paz mundial”
